problem: The Host Reality Twin packet correctly demands interface/failure-surface fidelity rather than silicon-identical emulation, but does not yet make the cheapest execution substrate and escalation boundary explicit. Treating every scenario as a full VM would consume more startup/RAM/coordination budget and still would not reproduce the physical UM790 board; treating every scenario as a namespace container would miss separate-kernel, boot and kernel-driver behavior.

architecture_delta.name: HRT_THREE_TIER_ESCALATION_FABRIC

tiers.name: FAST_USERSPACE_TWIN
purpose: user/session-shaped failure handling where reproducible in the container harness
network namespace/veth detach, rename, reconnect and impairment
mechanisms: tc-netem with recorded parameters and seed
dm-delay/dm-flakey only on dedicated disposable test storage
tiers.hard_limit: Shares the host kernel and deliberately restricts kernel/device authority; cannot prove a target kernel, AMD Phoenix firmware, Radeon 780M, USB4, Secure Boot or physical-device behavior.

tiers.name: KERNEL_BOOT_TWIN
escalate_when: the requirement depends on a separate kernel version/configuration
a fault must cross a guest-kernel boundary
Tier A cannot reproduce the relevant lifecycle without sharing the host kernel
tiers.device_policy: Prefer generic VirtIO for generic OS/device-lifecycle tests. A VirtIO PASS must never be narrated as proof of UM790-specific hardware-driver behavior.
tiers.cpu_policy: Host CPU passthrough may increase CPU feature similarity but cannot create motherboard/GPU/USB4/firmware identity.

tiers.name: PHYSICAL_TARGET_WITNESS
tiers.substrate: exact owner target host bound by TargetHostProfile generation/digest
tiers.entry_dependency: F2-WP-1201 TargetHostProfile or successor exact host-identity contract
purpose: physical acceptance and soak where required

escalation_contract: Run the lowest-cost tier capable of falsifying the current requirement.
Escalate A->B only when the unresolved proof obligation materially depends on a separate kernel/boot/device-model boundary.
Escalate A/B->C whenever the requirement minimum maturity is exact-host/real-readback/restart-recovery/soak or the suspected defect is physical-host-specific.
A PASS at a lower tier never satisfies a requirement whose minimum evidence maturity is above that tier's ceiling.
A failure at Tier A/B is useful pre-handoff negative evidence; a PASS is robustness evidence, not proof of absence of target-host defects.

wp1201_fusion.finding: The new WP-1201 primitive already supplies the correct Tier-C identity anchor: fixed allow-listed read-only technical probes, deterministic generation-bound digest, explicit OBSERVED/UNKNOWN records, and no completion credit by itself.
required_follow_on: Every Tier-A/B scenario receipt should record the simulated profile/image/kernel identity separately from the physical TargetHostProfile.
Every Tier-C host-specific receipt should bind TargetHostProfile generation + profile_digest_sha256.
When the target profile generation/digest changes materially, affected host-specific evidence must be re-evaluated rather than silently reused.

Tier_B_first_or_escalated: guest udev/device-model behavior requiring an independent kernel
Tier_C_mandatory: real PipeWire/Wayland permission/readback on the owner host

counterhypothesis: Maintaining two simulated substrates may create enough orchestration complexity that a single QEMU/KVM baseline is operationally cheaper overall.

next_discriminator.experiment: Run the same bounded fault subset in Tier A and Tier B using fixed images and identical pass/fail contracts; collect cold-start latency, steady RSS, setup LOC/config surface, deterministic replay rate, scenario coverage and defect discrimination. Collapse Tier A into Tier B if the cost/complexity advantage is not material.
next_discriminator.required_owner: Trigger-4 build/test lane or a separately claimed Trigger-6 reproducibility objective with an admitted execution surface

non_import_decision: Do not import a large orchestration framework at E2. Use thin native wrappers around systemd-nspawn/QEMU/ip/tc/systemd/device-mapper primitives so receipts can bind exact command/config/image identities and the project keeps one completion/evidence authority.
